sprintName: 6 LPA to 50 LPA AI Systems Engineer (30-Day Sprint)

days.title: Diagnostic Assessment & 50 LPA Rebranding
days.coreFocus: Rebrand resume, LinkedIn headline, and GitHub to 'AI Systems Engineer'. Position Data Analyst background as unfair advantage.
days.deliverable: Updated 1-page Resume draft + LinkedIn headline & bio tuned for AI Systems Engineering.

days.title: FastAPI & Async Python for AI Streaming
days.coreFocus: Build an async FastAPI service with Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming token-by-token LLM responses + Pydantic v2 schemas.
days.deliverable: Working standalone FastAPI streaming microservice with unit tests.

days.title: Dockerizing AI Agents & Microservices
days.coreFocus: Containerize the FastAPI AI service with multi-stage Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml including local database.
days.deliverable: One-click 'docker compose up' running service with healthchecks.

days.title: Stateful Multi-Agent Orchestration (LangGraph Patterns)
days.coreFocus: Implement a stateful supervisor-worker agent loop with cyclic decision making and error recovery.
days.deliverable: LangGraph state machine script executing multi-step autonomous research/code tasks.

days.title: Sandboxed Tool Execution & Safe SQL/Code Runners
days.coreFocus: Secure tool execution environment for agents to query databases and run code with strict timeouts and AST inspection.
days.deliverable: Secure code runner tool module with failure-handling tests.

days.title: Multimodal Engineering (Whisper ASR + Video Pipelines)
days.coreFocus: Programmatic video and audio synthesis architecture: Whisper word timestamps, TTS integration, and automated headless rendering.
days.deliverable: Architectural breakdown and clean CLI script of the Manodemy Video Engine.

days.title: Week 1 Capstone Integration & Milestone Gate
days.coreFocus: Package all Week 1 components into a clean, containerized multi-agent API service.
days.deliverable: GitHub repository with clean README, architecture diagram, and docker-compose.

days.title: Advanced RAG (Beyond Naive Vector Search)
days.coreFocus: Implement Hybrid Search (BM25 + Dense Vectors) with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) and Cross-Encoder Re-ranking.
days.deliverable: Hybrid RAG search module outperforming basic vector cosine similarity.

days.title: Agentic Memory & Contextual Chunking
days.coreFocus: Designing episodic vs semantic agent memory and contextual document chunking for complex analytics datasets.
days.deliverable: Memory manager class supporting conversation recall and long-term facts.

days.title: LLM Observability, Tracing & Evals (LangSmith/Ragas)
days.coreFocus: Instrumenting agent traces, tracking latency/costs, and setting up automated evaluation benchmarks for hallucinations.
days.deliverable: Evaluation suite script calculating faithfulness and answer relevancy scores.

days.title: Production Cost & Latency Optimization
days.coreFocus: Semantic caching (Redis/GPTCache), prompt compression, and model routing (small fast models vs heavy reasoning models).
days.deliverable: Routing proxy that slashes token cost by 60% with zero quality degradation.

days.title: Packaging Manodemy into a World-Class Portfolio Repo
days.coreFocus: Turning the Manodemy multi-agent engine into a stunning open-source showcase with animated GIFs, system architecture, and 1-line setup.
days.deliverable: Public GitHub repo with an elite README designed to impress CTOs.

days.title: The 90-Second Hypnotic Loom Video Demo
days.coreFocus: Scripting, recording, and publishing a crisp 90-second Loom showing the live working multi-agent video generator & SQL sandbox.
days.deliverable: Published Loom link ready to be pasted into founder DMs.

days.title: Week 2 Capstone Review & Public Launch
days.coreFocus: Reviewing all artifacts, publishing the demo on LinkedIn/X, and stress-testing public endpoints.
days.deliverable: Live public demo link + social post published.

days.title: The Anti-Naukri Infiltration Target List
days.coreFocus: Curating 50 high-paying Series A/B AI startups (Bangalore) and US Remote AI companies hiring for AI/Agentic roles.
days.deliverable: CRM spreadsheet of 50 vetted companies with Founder/CTO LinkedIn and X handles.

days.title: Crafting Irresistible Founder Cold Infiltration Pitches
days.coreFocus: Writing high-converting, personalized 3-sentence DM templates embedding the Loom demo and specific company pain-points.
days.deliverable: 3 tested pitch variations with dynamic personalization placeholders.

days.title: Launching Outreach Engine (Batch 1: 15 Founders)
days.coreFocus: Sending personalized video pitches to the first 15 target founders/CTOs via LinkedIn and Twitter/X.
days.deliverable: 15 DMs sent and logged in outreach_pipeline.json.

days.title: Viral Technical 'Build-in-Public' LinkedIn Post
days.coreFocus: Publishing an in-depth technical post: 'How I built an autonomous multi-agent video pipeline with Whisper and Headless Browsers'.
days.deliverable: LinkedIn post live with high-engagement technical breakdown.

days.title: Outreach Batch 2 & Value-Add Follow Ups
days.coreFocus: Sending next 15 founder DMs + sending insightful follow-up bumps to Batch 1 with fresh architecture updates.
days.deliverable: 30 total founders reached + initial response analysis.

days.title: Dominating the 15-Minute Founder Fit Call
days.coreFocus: Mastering the founder screening conversation: Transitioning from Data Analyst to AI Builder, leading with demo, securing tech round.
days.deliverable: Scripted answers to top 5 founder screening questions.

days.title: Week 3 Pipeline Review (Minimum 3-5 Rounds Scheduled)
days.coreFocus: Auditing responses, scheduling interviews, and prioritizing high-probability 50 LPA opportunities.
days.deliverable: Confirmed interview calendar with at least 3 active loops.

days.title: System Design 1: Autonomous Multi-Agent Support Engine
days.coreFocus: Designing end-to-end agentic workflow: Intent routing, human-in-the-loop escalation, state persistence, idempotency.
days.deliverable: Excalidraw/Mermaid system design diagram with complete component breakdown.

days.title: System Design 2: High-Throughput Multimodal Generation
days.coreFocus: Designing scalable video/audio rendering pipelines: Queue workers (Celery/BullMQ), S3 storage, worker autoscaling.
days.deliverable: Architecture spec for processing 10,000 automated videos/day with zero downtime.

days.title: System Design 3: Scalable Enterprise RAG (10M+ Docs)
days.coreFocus: Designing enterprise knowledge retrieval: Chunking strategies, vector index sharding (Qdrant/Milvus), latency caching, SLA guarantees.
days.deliverable: System design write-up for sub-200ms enterprise RAG.

days.title: Live Mock Interview Drill: System Design & Failure Modes
days.coreFocus: Intensive 45-minute live drill with Teacher grill-session on LLM failure recovery, rate limits, and schema drift.
days.deliverable: Scored mock session with identified fixes logged in memory.

days.title: Live Mock Interview Drill: Tool-Calling & Live Coding
days.coreFocus: Fast-paced live coding session: Building an agent tool from scratch in 30 minutes with error handling.
days.deliverable: Clean runnable code under timed pressure.

days.title: The 50 LPA Salary Anchoring Negotiation Masterclass
days.coreFocus: Mastering the compensation dialogue: Neutralizing the 6 LPA current CTC trap, anchoring at ₹48–52 LPA, handling lowball offers.
days.deliverable: Word-for-word negotiation scripts for HR calls and offer letters.

days.title: Offer Evaluation & Counter-Offer Dynamics
days.coreFocus: Analyzing offer packages: Base salary, performance bonus, ESOP vesting schedules, tax optimization, counter-offer tactics.
days.deliverable: Offer comparison sheet and counter-offer communication draft.

days.title: Final Readiness Inspection & Mindset Polish
days.coreFocus: Comprehensive check of all active loops, closing open discussions, final offer negotiation execution.
days.deliverable: Final negotiation round completion.

days.title: VICTORY GATE: 50 LPA Offer Secured
days.coreFocus: Celebrating the 6 LPA to 50 LPA transformation. Documenting lessons learned and onboarding roadmap as an elite AI Systems Engineer.
days.deliverable: Signed 50 LPA Offer Letter & Career Transformation Manifesto.
